title: Toronto Downtown Party Bike Tour with Bar Stop
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Toronto from a new perspective as you pedal a party bike through the city’s vibrant downtown. Start your adventure at a central meeting point, hop on with your group or join new friends, and enjoy drinks served chilled from your onboard cooler.

Cruise past landmarks like the CN Tower, with music playing and two party Pilots keeping the energy high - one steering, one serving. Along the way, capture memories at a dedicated photo stop with the city as your backdrop.

Your tour wraps up at 250 Adelaide St W - it's one building with a bunch of bars: Rock N Horse (country bar), Dublin Calling (Irish bar), and The Porch (rooftop patio). You can decide which one you want to go to when you arrive!

With guaranteed reservations and drink specials, this is a unique way to celebrate with friends or meet new people. All drinks for the bike must be pre-ordered; outside alcohol is not allowed. Please bring a valid ID and arrive ready to pedal and party!
